added.name: Manifold
added.long_description:
The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. 

Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. 

Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.
added.one_liner: Low-cost, deployment-ready robotic labor for warehouses

added.name: Last Accounting Company
added.long_description:
Last Accounting Company (LAC) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

LAC replaces both outsourced accountants and legacy accounting software for startups and SMBs. Our system is fully proprietary, from the general ledger to the accounting agents. This allows us to create powerful self-reinforcing loops and ultimately provide a state-of-the-art accounting service.

long_description.before:
CoAsync by Cognitio Labs is the AI back office for product quality and compliance.

We help mission-critical food manufacturers automate repetitive, document-intensive workflows across Certificates of Analysis (COAs), lab reports, supplier documents, product specifications, and quality records.

We started with Certificates of Analysis (COAs), one of the many workflows quality teams manage before products can ship. Today, this work is still performed manually across PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and disconnected ERP systems.

CoAsync automates the workflow by:

Reading supplier documents
Extracting laboratory data
Validating product specifications
Applying compliance requirements
Drafting compliant COAs
Organizing audit-ready documentation

Results from one of our initial deployments with a mid-market food processor:

85% less QA administrative work
4× more COAs processed per shift
1-2 hours saved per document
New product onboarding in under one day

COAs are just the beginning. Our vision is to build the AI back office for product quality and compliance across regulated industries by automating the many document-intensive workflows manufacturers manage every day.

Backed by Y Combinator and leading investors. Founder Diva Avaya Sharma has presented example AI workflows for product quality and compliance through the World Economic Forum Centre for Advanced Manufacturing and Supply Chains' SmartStart initiative and at the International Telecommunication Union's AI for Good Global Summit, organized in partnership with the United Nations.

Learn more and get started with your documents: https://cognitioiq.com

long_description.before:
AI Agents have arrived. They are powerful enough to read, plan, and act across your everyday life and work. The question is no longer whether they can run canned demos to check the weather, it’s whether real teams can rely on them for critical work. We optimize for adoption over spectacle: useful, accountable systems that help top professional complete real tasks.

Wordware is backed by Spark Capital, Felicis, and Y Combinator, with a $30M seed round. Our beautiful, historic San Francisco office sits in the shadow of the Golden Gate Bridge, it’s full of plants and radiates innovation and calm. We genuinely love working together. At lunch we talk about alignment and AI consciousness, we have surfboards in the office ready to use, we take walking meetings on the beach and hang out after work at the bar or climbing wall. We work really hard because we care deeply about what we do.

Sauna is Wordware’s AI workspace for professionals. Think ‘Cursor for Knowledge Work’ and you’re halfway there. With explicit permission, it connects to tools like Gmail, Calendar, Slack, and thousands more, to gather the right context to move your work forward. It learns who you are, drafts and refines your documents, presentations, and datasets, researches across the web and your org’s internal knowledge, summarizes long threads to cut through the noise, proposes next steps, even acts on your behalf when enabled. You can work with Sauna live, side-by-side, or schedule jobs to run automatically in the background, with clear permissions and easy off-switches. Sauna brings the power of AI Agents to all professionals.
long_description.after: Most AI products hand you a coworker on day one and hope you trust it. Sauna is the coworker you raise: it starts by learning how you work, earns autonomy task by task, and ends up running hours of work on its own while you keep taste, review, and the final say. Wordware is the ~20-person team behind it, backed by Spark Capital, Felicis, and Y Combinator with a $30M seed, the largest in YC history. We build from a San Francisco office in the shadow of the Golden Gate Bridge, and we work absurdly hard because we can see and feel the outcome every day.

Wildcard is the AEO and GEO platform designed specifically for e-commerce and retail brands. We help merchants improve visibility across AI search and AI shopping platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Amazon Rufus.

Wildcard tracks how brands, categories, collections, and SKUs appear across AI search results, identifies visibility gaps, and turns those insights into actions. We use AI agents to enrich product data, generate SEO, AEO, and GEO content, create collection and comparison pages, build FAQs, and improve off-site discoverability across Reddit, YouTube, blogs, and other sources.

As AI shopping evolves, Wildcard is building the infrastructure brands need to win in agentic commerce, including support for emerging standards like the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP).

We audit and action on how you show up across across AI search and AI shopping platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Amazon Rufus/Alexa, and Walmart Sparky. long_description.before:
Skillsync is a real-time multiplayer coding agent with shared memory. Teams build with coding agents together, live, in the terminal or a Discord-like app, then every session becomes searchable memory the whole team and its agents can reuse.

Today, all the thinking behind your code lives inside individual agent sessions and evaporates the moment they close. The reasoning, what was tried, what was rejected, the taste that sets your best engineers apart, just becomes tribal knowledge stuck in a few heads. Skillsync captures it. We're formalizing engineering culture, so how your team uniquely builds becomes explicit, shared, and reusable.
long_description.after:
Skillsync lets you push your agents' sessions the way you push code. Everything lands in one searchable place. The best sessions become skills any agent can load. Works across your team!

Today, all that thinking, what worked, what didn't, and why, is scattered across Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, whatever each engineer prefers. It vanishes when the session closes. Skillsync captures it, so every agent builds like your best engineer. The more your team ships, the smarter your agents get. Engineering culture stops being tribal knowledge. It becomes explicit, shared, and reusable.
